# prompt-regression

> Compare recorded outputs of two prompt versions over the same dataset and report unchanged, changed, improved, regressed, added and removed cases. Python package `trysac-prompt-regression`, import name `prompt_regression`, MIT licensed, Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
